settings.flush: flush.zero_() on 4x L2 before every sample
settings.order: Williams balanced Latin square, one row per block, the same for every case

clocks.cuda_graph_ms: CUDA events around graph.replay() of a warm capture
clocks.eager_event_ms: CUDA events around an eager call
clocks.wall_ms: host perf_counter between two synchronizes around an eager call

settings.error: ||Q - P||_F / sqrt(n) against baselines.svd_polar_fp64 (FP64 SVD polar factor)
settings.supersedes: latency fields of results/schatten_switch_search_cycle2.json (tier1 and latency_sanity), measured before the sync-free path; that file is unchanged

launch_counts.method: torch.profiler CUDA kernel events of one warm call; Memcpy and Memset are not kernels
